description: Taste-locked frontend workflow for coding agents: vague brief to 70-80% slop-free UI via the frontend-kit orchestrator, Impeccable's deterministic detector, and a Playwright screenshot loop. Skills in ./skills/ are auto-discovered by Gemini CLI; the full kit (GSAP skills, Impeccable variants, reference data) is installed by ./install.sh.
name: frontend-agent-kit
